name: Camping Guggemos
beschreibung: The Camping Guggemos is located in Füssen (according to information in Tirol) on the shore of the Forggensee. The site offers parceled pitches for motorhomes and caravans with electricity supply. The sanitary building is equipped with showers, washbasins, and a chemical toilet disposal facility. A kiosk supplies guests with fresh baked goods and drinks. From the campsite, hiking trails lead to the surrounding Alps and cycle paths run along the lake.
